Episode Notes:
Gary sits down with retired Marine lieutenant colonel Matt Worsham, a prior enlisted intelligence officer who transitioned first into a career in technology and now co-hosts The REEL DMV as an actor. They reflect on a pivotal 1998 USS Essex deployment, explore the close-knit community of Marine signals intelligence, and discuss civilian career lessons, with Matt emphasizing that no one owes veterans anything. He shares how losing his job at Microsoft led him to acting, what teamwork involves on set, and how commanders can support Marines in developing identities beyond their military roles.
